topic.readerProblem: Measure answer presence, cited-source evidence, and downstream business behavior without collapsing them into one misleading score.
topic.connection: Extends AEOeye audit evidence into a repeatable analytics model with explicit denominators and attribution limits.

assessment: Reviewed the full measurement guide, formulas, sample table, source claims, images, internal links, and FAQs. The article consistently separates answer observations, citations, referrals, and outcomes; it does not claim that a citation caused a visit or that identifiable referral traffic represents all AI influence.

sources.supports: Google AI feature eligibility and the inclusion of AI-feature traffic in overall Search Console Web reporting.
Google Analytics default channel-group basis and the limits of observable referral classification.
Bing citation, cited-page, grounding-query, and trend metrics plus their stated interpretation limits.
Governance basis for preserving evidence, documenting uncertainty, and reviewing AI-related measurement risk.

checks: Recalculated every displayed rate from its stated numerator and denominator and verified that missing runs cannot silently count as negative answers.
Checked the answer, citation, and business layers remain separate in the opening, schema, dashboard, reporting, and FAQ sections.
Verified all six internal links resolve and the two inline images plus credited header image are present in the final file.
